_comment_purpose: ISH-09 (customer-provisioning-orchestration-r1 Wave 5 punchlist, 2026-08-27). Companion documentation for the /provision-environment SKILL.md Step 0.5b substitution map. Records every {token} that prereqs.yaml recipes reference, the source that populates it, and the current expected shape for the dev environment. Read this file BEFORE adding a new prereqs.yaml recipe — it tells you whether a new {token} needs (a) a runtime az-derived derivation added to SKILL.md Step 0.5b, (b) a per-env constant added to spaarke-constants.yaml per_env_constants.dev, or (c) an intake-schema field the operator supplies at intake time.
_comment_authority: spaarke-constants.yaml + SKILL.md Step 0.5b are the RUNTIME authorities — the skill actually reads those. This file is DOCUMENTATION-ONLY and does NOT bind runtime substitution. Kept in sync via validate.ps1 cross-check (a token in prereqs.yaml missing from this map fails author-time validation).

customerId.shape: kebab-case string, 3-32 chars, starts with letter
customerId.note: Session variable; per-customer prereqs (once_per_customer) reference this.

runId.note: Not used in Step 0.5b prereqs (only in server-side logs); documented here for completeness.

env.populatedBy: intake.schema.json controlPlaneEnv property (also -Env CLI arg; ISH-12 SESSION 18 rename from `environment` → `controlPlaneEnv`)
env.note: Feeds most name_templates in spaarke-constants.yaml (l2UamiName, sbNamespace, artifactsStorageName, acrName, platformKvName, platformResourceGroup, registryDvUrl).

region.shape: Azure region string (e.g. westus2, westus3, eastus2)
region.populatedBy: intake.schema.json region property; aliased to openAiRegion in Step 0.5b
region.note: Currently interchangeable with openAiRegion at substitution time — canonical Spaarke split is platform=westus2, openai=westus3.

openAiRegion.shape: Azure OpenAI region (defaults to westus3 when omitted)
openAiRegion.populatedBy: intake.schema.json openAiRegion property; SKILL.md Step 0.5b applies westus3 default
openAiRegion.note: Referenced by PRQ-E-14 OpenAI model catalog + drives H2a OpenAiLocation override (see H2aBicepInfraDeployHandler.OpenAiLocationParameterKey).

subId.note: Aliased to {sub} at substitution time. For Model 2 dedicated stamps intake.schema.json.subscriptionId is the operator-supplied override; Model 1 shared trials read the operator's default subscription.

sub.note: Kept for pre-PLX-08 recipe compatibility; new recipes SHOULD use {subId}.

l2UamiPrincipalId.populatedBy: az identity show -g rg-spaarke-platform-{env} -n sprk-controlplane-{env}-uami --query principalId
l2UamiPrincipalId.note: L2 control-plane UAMI — required for all outbound RBAC checks (PRQ-S-04, PRQ-E-05..07, PRQ-E-11).

l2UamiClientId.note: Fed into Dataverse systemuser lookup (PRQ-E-10) — Application-User applicationid == this clientId.

l2UamiSpId.shape: Service principal object id for the UAMI (GUID)
l2UamiSpId.populatedBy: az ad sp show --id {l2UamiClientId} --query id -o tsv
l2UamiSpId.note: Used for Graph app-role assignment lookups (PRQ-E-09).

graphAppId.note: Invariant across all Entra tenants — hardcoded as 00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000.

sbNamespace.note: Referenced by PRQ-E-06 (Service Bus SB Data Sender/Receiver RBAC) + PRQ-E-08 (queue existence).

sbName.populatedBy: Alias used by some pre-existing recipe strings
sbName.note: TODO reconcile with {sbNamespace} — currently only appears in one recipe reference body (PRQ-E-08 example body). Safe to consolidate.

artifactsStorageId.shape: Azure resource id of the platform artifacts storage account
artifactsStorageId.populatedBy: az storage account show -g rg-spaarke-platform-{env} -n sprk{env}artifacts --query id -o tsv
artifactsStorageId.note: Full resource id (not just name) — RBAC scope for PRQ-E-05 (Storage Blob Data Reader).

acrId.shape: Azure resource id of the platform ACR
acrId.populatedBy: az acr show -g rg-spaarke-platform-{env} -n sprk{env}acr --query id -o tsv
acrId.note: RBAC scope for PRQ-E-06 (AcrPull for L2 worker sidecar image pulls).

bffAppServiceId.shape: Azure resource id of the BFF App Service (per-env)
bffAppServiceId.note: RBAC scope for PRQ-E-07 (Website Contributor for slot swaps).

kvResourceId.shape: Azure resource id of the platform Key Vault
kvResourceId.populatedBy: az keyvault show -g rg-spaarke-platform-{env} -n sprk-{env}-kv --query id -o tsv
kvResourceId.note: RBAC scope for PRQ-E-11 (Key Vault Secrets User for the L2 UAMI on the platform KV).

containerTypeId.populatedBy: spaarke-constants.yaml per_env_constants.dev.containerTypeId (operator MUST populate before first Step 0.5 run)
containerTypeId.note: SPE container-type on the Spaarke tenant. Never changes once created (owner directive 2026-08-24 SPE never_delete). If null, SKILL.md Step 0.5b hard-stops with a targeted operator-facing error.

bffAppId.shape: Entra app registration appId for the BFF (per-tenancy tier)
bffAppId.note: One per tenancy tier, shared across all Model 1 customers. Currently referenced only in PRQ-T-02 tightening (Wave 4 deferred).

dvUrl.populatedBy: Runtime — read from customer sprk_dataverseenvironment row post-Step 1f
dvUrl.note: Only appears in per-customer once_per_customer scoped prereqs (deferred to H0 server-side per EXEC-10).

adminDvUrl.note: Registry env — per operator memory feedback_no_central_managing_env_yet, spaarkedev1 doubles as dev + registry until a central-managing env exists.

pinnedVer.populatedBy: PRQ-E-14 recipe now iterates in-line — single-placeholder pattern deleted per Wave 3 PRQ-03 refactor.
pinnedVer.note: No substitution required; the recipe body owns the pin loop internally.
